We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

 About the role: 

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

 Key Responsibilities: 

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

 What you need to be successful: 

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

 Soft Skills: 

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

 Other useful skills: 

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

 Supervision and collaboration: 

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

 Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

 Subsidized gym memberships

 Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

 International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

 Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

 Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

 Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

 Answering phones and emails

 Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

 Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

 Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

 Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

 Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

 Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

 Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

 Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

 Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 Required Skills and Qualifications

 Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

 Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

 Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

 Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

 Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

 Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 Preferred Skills 

 The following experience is preferred but not required:

 Intermediate spreadsheet skills

 Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

 Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

 Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 Remote Work Environment 

 Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 Growth Opportunity 

 This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 Compensation 

 For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
